description: This file contains utility methods for handling entity models in the Apache OFBiz framework, including string case conversions, name transformations between database and Java conventions, name shortening, package path conversion, SQL type inference, and localization checks.

classes.name: ModelUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for string manipulation, name conversions, SQL type inference, and localization checks related to entity models.

methods.name: upperFirstChar
methods.description: Converts the first character of a string to uppercase.

methods.name: lowerFirstChar
methods.description: Converts the first character of a string to lowercase.

methods.name: dbNameToClassName
methods.description: Converts a database name (underscore separated uppercase) to a Java class name in CamelCase.

methods.name: dbNameToVarName
methods.description: Converts a database name to a Java variable name in camelCase.

methods.name: javaNameToDbName
methods.description: Converts a Java variable name to a database name in uppercase with underscores.

methods.name: shortenDbName
methods.description: Shortens a database name to a desired length by removing vowels and characters from segments.

methods.name: packageToPath
methods.description: Converts a package name to a platform-independent file path.

methods.name: replaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string.

methods.name: induceFieldType
methods.description: Infers a field type based on SQL type name, length, and precision.

methods.name: isPotentialLocalizedField
methods.description: Checks if a ModelEntity has a default resource for localization for a specific field.

methods.name: isPotentialLocalizedFields
methods.description: Checks if a ModelEntity has default resources for localization for a list of fields or view entity aliases.
